page.title: Shape your reading space.
page.description: Choose a reading flow, editions, and display details that help you return to the Quran with focus.

theme.quickHint: Choose a theme. Your selection applies and saves automatically.
theme.title: Theme
theme.description: Choose how the application looks across every page.
theme.label: Theme

language.title: Language
language.description: Choose the language used by the application interface.
language.label: Language

arabicTextSize.title: Arabic text size
arabicTextSize.description: Adjust Quran text to the size that feels most comfortable to read.
arabicTextSize.label: Arabic text size

readingMode.title: Reading mode
readingMode.description: Choose the way you would like to move through the Quran.
readingMode.label: Reading mode

riwayah.title: Riwayah
riwayah.description: Choose the Quranic transmission used for Arabic text and recitation.
riwayah.label: Riwayah

translationVisibility.title: Show translation
translationVisibility.description: Display English beneath the Arabic text.

continuousRecitation.title: Continuous recitation
continuousRecitation.description: After an ayah finishes, continue with the next ayah in your current reading view.

notifications.title: Notification preferences
notifications.description: Choose which reminders you want to receive.
notifications.enabledFeedback: Your selected notifications are enabled on this device.
notifications.disabledFeedback: Notifications have been disabled on this device.
notifications.errorFeedback: We could not update notification settings.
notifications.blockedHint: Notifications are blocked in Chrome. Allow them for this app in your browser or system settings, then return here.

wird.title: Daily Wird
wird.description: Remind me near the end of the day when my Wird is unfinished.

meetings.title: Circle meetings
meetings.description: Remind me 15 minutes before a meeting and tell me when the host starts it.

assignments.title: Group assignments
assignments.description: Tell me about new assignments, approaching deadlines, and review results.

status.unsupported: Push notifications are not supported here
status.disabled: Reminders are off on this device
status.enabled: Reminders are active on this device

offline.title: Complete offline Quran
offline.description: Hafs, Warsh, and an English translation are kept on this device automatically. Audio still needs an internet connection.

status.error: Download paused — it will retry online
status.unsupported: Offline storage is not supported here

arabicEdition.title: Arabic edition
arabicEdition.description: Choose the Arabic text style used throughout the reader.
arabicEdition.warshDescription: Warsh uses its dedicated Quran script; your Hafs edition remains saved for when you switch back.
arabicEdition.label: Edition

reciter.title: Reciter
reciter.description: Choose the voice used for ayah playback and full recitation.
reciter.label: Reciter
reciter.warshPageHint: Warsh page mode supports full-page recitation only; individual ayah playback and highlighting are hidden because recording boundaries vary by source.
reciter.surahHint: Surah mode supports ayah-by-ayah and whole-surah reciters.
reciter.pageHint: Page mode uses reciters with audio for each ayah.

translation.title: English translation
translation.description: Set the translation shown alongside the Arabic text.
translation.label: English edition

editions.hilali: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali and Muhammad Muhsin Khan
editions.qaribullah: Hasan al-Fatih Qaribullah and Ahmad Darwish

tafsir.title: Tafsir edition
tafsir.description: Choose the commentary that will be used when you explore an ayah.
tafsir.label: Tafsir

footer.note: Changes will apply to your next reading session.
footer.success: Your reading preferences have been saved.
